newsitem.title: SPAIN: Sevillana H1 net profit rises 22.9 percent.
newsitem.headline: Sevillana H1 net profit rises 22.9 percent.

text.p: Results for first half in billions of pesetas, unless stated:

NOTE- Sevillana de Electricidad said the rise in profit was due to lower operating costs, improved financial results as a result of a sharp drop in debt and lower interest rates, and a rise in electricity demand. Demand in Sevillana's supply area grew 4.4 percent from the same period last year, compared with 2.2 percent for the sector as a whole. Debt has fallen by more than half since December 1995 to around 130 billion pesetas, following the sale of bonds issued to finance Spain's nuclear debt.
